Senior SAP ABAP & Fiori Technical Consultant - S/4HANA & BTP
description:
Design, build, and support SAP ABAP and Fiori enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms, and applications aligned to business requirements. Role Overview A technical role delivered under a strict clean-core mandate. The program has deliberately constrained its build: 79% of requirements are met by standard configuration, and the WRICEF objects will be gated behind conditions precedent - a validated requirement, a quantified benefit, and confirmation that no standard alternative exists - and extensions are delivered on SAP BTP rather than by modifying the core. This role needs judgment as well as skill: the largest technical risk on the program is over-customization, specifically rebuilding a legacy shop-floor system''s bespoke lot-numbering and lot-handling logic one-for-one inside SAP. You will be expected to resist that. Key Responsibilities Translate functional specifications from all workstreams into technical designs, honest estimates and clean-core-compliant build approaches; challenge designs better solved by configuration.Develop the report backlog using CDS views, RAP services and analytical Fiori applications in preference to classical ABAP list reports.Develop enhancements using released extension points - BAdIs, key-user and developer extensibility - rather than core modifications or implicit enhancements.Design and build interfaces between S/4HANA, SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation and edge systems and the analytics layer, using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) plus IDoc, OData, REST and file patterns.Build custom and extended Fiori applications with SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English language support.Build the traveler / batch-card print program and forms carrying resolved machine, tool, hardness, mold, cavity and lot detail; implement quality, hold and disposition approval workflows; build the flexible master-data maintenance application if it clears its gate.Build the composite KPI CDS layer and the post-Material-Ledger allocation engine in the agreed architecture; enforce clean-core governance - extension registry, released-API discipline, upgrade-safety review, code review - and document objects so client IT can maintain them. BATCH MANAGEMENT TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE - REQUIRED Hands-on Batch Management and end-to-end traceability experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. Batch, lot and cavity-level traceability sits at the center of this program; candidates without demonstrable hands-on experience in the following will not be shortlisted:Batch and classification data structures in S/4HANA - batch master, characteristics and classification, batch determination and status - and how to read, extend and report on them without breaking standard behavior.Batch number assignment: standard internal/external number ranges, the batch number BAdI, and the judgment to say honestly when a bespoke lot-number format genuinely cannot be met by standard next-number maintenance. Replicating legacy lot-numbering one-for-one is this program''s largest over-customization risk.Batch characteristic copying and re-derivation on split and merge, including enhancement programs that update collected data each time a shop-floor control number is split.Cavity-level and sub-lot data: carrying mold, machine and cavity identity onto batch characteristics and onto planned/production orders via custom fields, and surfacing it on travelers, labels and packing documents.Traceability reporting: building forward/backward genealogy queries over batch data with CDS, integrating with the Batch Information Cockpit and Global Batch Traceability rather than rebuilding them.Interfaces that carry batch identity - SFC-to-batch one-to-one mapping with the digital manufacturing layer, vendor batch capture, batch data on delivery documents - and the handling of long (up to 40-digit) lot numbers through splits, an open design decision on this program. Required Qualifications 6+ years SAP technical development with 3+ full-lifecycle implementations, including at least 1 on S/4HANA.Strong ABAP OO and ABAP on HANA: CDS views, AMDP, code pushdown and performance optimization; hands-on RAP and modern extensibility (key-user and developer extensibility, released APIs, BAdIs).Demonstrable clean-core delivery: extensions that survive upgrades, and the discipline to refuse core modifications.SAPUI5 / Fiori development including Fiori Elements, annotations, custom controls and launchpad configuration.Hands-on SAP BTP including Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management) and event-based integration; Cloud Foundry or Kyma application development is an advantage.SAP integration technologies: OData, REST, SOAP, IDoc, ALE/EDI, the Data Replication Framework and file-based interfaces; forms and print output (Adobe Forms or SmartForms) for travelers, labels and packing documents.Development against PP, QM and MM/IM/WM with a working functional understanding of what those modules do. Preferred Qualifications Bilingual English/Japanese (business level); prior delivery in Japan, including multi-language UI and print output.Integrating SAP Digital Manufacturing or an MES with S/4HANA, and machine/edge connectivity patterns (OPC UA; bridging non-standard protocols such as CC-Link via middleware or an edge gateway is a distinct advantage).Analytical CDS models consumed by SAP Analytics Cloud or SAP Business Data Cloud.SAP Build Process Automation or SAP Workflow Management.ABAP Test Cockpit, abapGit, gCTS and CI/CD for SAP.SAP certification in ABAP for S/4HANA, Fiori application development, or BTP Integration Suite. Language Requirement - Bilingual English/Japanese Preferred, Not Required Fluent professional English is required for design documentation, deliverables and steering-committee communication. Business-level Japanese is a strong advantage - many process owners, shop-floor personnel and legacy-system custodians work primarily in Japanese, and much current-state documentation exists only in Japanese - but it is not a condition of appointment. Interpretation support, bilingual design documentation and pairing with bilingual business analysts are provided, and strong candidates will be considered regardless of Japanese-language ability. Engagement Details Full-time consulting assignment across the Explore, Realize and Deploy phases. Hybrid delivery with periodic on-site presence at the Japan sites during validation workshops, integration testing, cutover and hypercare. Reports to the workstream lead, working alongside client SMEs, client IT and the corporate global SAP template and clean-core governance teams. Top 4 Job Requirements For This Role Clean-core development discipline - CDS, RAP and released extension points only, with the discipline to refuse core modifications and challenge builds better solved by configuration. SAP BTP Integration Suite - Cloud Integration, API Management and event-based integration to SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation systems and the analytics layer. Fiori and SAPUI5 delivery - Fiori Elements and custom applications, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English support. Batch and lot data expertise - batch classification, the batch number BAdI, characteristic re-derivation on split, and the judgment to resist rebuilding legacy lot logic. Required - see highlighted section below. Relocation Supported: No Visa Sponsorship Approved: No At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it''s the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences. 
 Location - Pune,Noida,Chennai,Hyderabad,Bengaluru

title: DCO Front End Developer
description:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for a DCO Frontend Developer with a strong foundation in dynamic creative (DCO) implementations to build scalable, high\-performance digital ad experiences across web, display, social, and video environments. This role focuses primarily on frontend engineering, component\-based architecture, performance optimization, and responsive creative development, while also supporting dynamic creative integrations, feed\-driven logic, and campaign activation workflows. You will collaborate closely with creative, media, and product teams to translate design concepts into robust, reusable frontend solutions that power personalized and data\-driven advertising experiences
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Design and develop high\-quality, performant frontend applications and ad creatives using modern web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript).
* Build and maintain modular, reusable, and scalable creative templates and UI components.
* Ensure cross\-browser, cross\-device compatibility and responsive/adaptive design across all environments.
* Optimize assets for performance, load speed, and runtime efficiency, especially in constrained ad\-serving environments.
* Integrate dynamic data feeds (JSON, XML, CSV, APIs) to enable personalization and content variation.
* Implement and manage basic DCO logic, including creative variations, dynamic content insertion, and conditional rendering.
* Collaborate with designers to translate Figma/Adobe designs into pixel\-perfect, interactive experiences.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues across browsers, devices, and ad platforms.
* Participate in code reviews, version control workflows, and frontend best practices implementation.
* Work with cross\-functional teams (creative, media, production) to ensure smooth delivery and deployment of campaigns.
* Support campaign launches and QA, ensuring accuracy and functionality of dynamic creatives.


**Requirements** 
**:**
* Strong experience in HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Experience building responsive and adaptive UIs across devices and screen sizes.
* Proficiency with JavaScript animation libraries such as GSAP, CreateJS, or similar.
* Familiarity with component\-based architecture and reusable design systems.
* Strong understanding of performance optimization techniques (lazy loading, asset compression, efficient DOM manipulation).
* Experience with cross\-browser compatibility and debugging tools.
* Working knowledge of Git and version control workflows.
* Experience with SASS/SCSS and modern CSS methodologies.
* Familiarity with Figma and design\-to\-development workflows.
* Understanding of web accessibility (WCAG) and W3C standards.


**Nice to Haves:**
* Experience with creative tools such as Adobe Animate, After Effects, Photoshop, or Illustrator.
* Exposure to dynamic ad platforms like Celtra, Innovid, or Smartly.
* Knowledge of video ad formats (VAST/VPAID) and rich media creatives.
* Understanding of programmatic advertising ecosystem fundamentals.
* Familiarity with basic backend/API integration concepts for data\-driven experiences.
* Interest or exposure to AI/automation in frontend or creative workflows.


**Technical Skills**
* Core: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6\+)
* Styling: SASS/SCSS, responsive design
* Animation: GSAP, CreateJS
* Data Handling: JSON, XML, CSV
* Tools: Git, Figma, Adobe Suite
* Standards: WCAG, W3C, cross\-browser compatibility.


**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
   

  

**Inclusion and Impact**
 WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

**Data**
 We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
   

  

**Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.**
